'''Malik "Shake" Milton''' (born September 26, 1996) is a former American [[college basketball]] player for the [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU Mustangs]] who has declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]].

== Career ==

=== High school ===
Milton played under Coach Mark Vancuren at [[Owasso High School]] in [[Owasso, Oklahoma]], earning [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]] honors for the state of [[Oklahoma]] in the 2013-14 season.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.tulsaworld.com/communities/owasso/sports/basketball/shake-milton-named-gatorade-player-of-the-year/article_40e31c52-fc16-5142-b10a-27cb39fe6e7a.html|title=Shake Milton named Gatorade Player of the Year|last=rickh@owassoreporter.com|first=Rick Heaton Sports Editor|work=Tulsa World|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en}}</ref> He averaged 29.7 points and 4.4 assists as a senior (2015-16) on his way to being named Oklahoma Super 5 Player of the Year.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://newsok.com/article/5411631|title=Oklahoman Super 5 boys basketball first team|date=2015-04-18|work=NewsOK.com|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en-US}}</ref> He committed to SMU over [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]] and [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.tulsaworld.com/sportsextra/okpreps/basketball/owasso-s-shake-milton-commits-to-smu-over-ou-indiana/article_33e49d75-28f0-5104-b055-262016b7e5c0.html|title=Owasso's Shake Milton commits to SMU over OU, Indiana|last=Writer|first=BARRY LEWIS World Sports|work=Tulsa World|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en}}</ref>

=== College ===
In his rookie year at SMU, Milton saw the hardwood in 30 games (23 starts) to average 10.5 points, 3.0 boards and 2.7 assists a contest, while earning AAC All-Rookie Team distinction.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/smumustangs/2016/03/08/smus-nic-moore-named-aac-first-team-mustangs-snubbed|title=SMU's Nic Moore named to all-AAC first team; other Mustangs snubbed  {{!}} SportsDay|date=2016-03-08|work=SportsDay|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en}}</ref>

In the summer of 2016, he was a member of the US Select Team for the Goodwill Tour in [[Croatia]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.globalsportsacademyus.com/Global_Sports_Academy_2016_Select_Team_Tour_Croatia_Baldwin_rv.pdf|title=2016 Select Team Basketball Goodwill Tour Croatia|last=|first=|date=|website=globalsportsacademyus.com|archive-url=|archive-date=|dead-url=|access-date=2017-07-18}}</ref>

The 2016-17 season saw him start in all 35 games and produce averages of 13.0 points, 4.5 assists and 1.3 steals per outing, he made the All-American Athletic Conference Second Team as a sophomore.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.tulsaworld.com/sportsextra/tusportsextra/owasso-s-shake-milton-selected-to-aac-second-team/article_a9118127-0990-5586-827f-223afba26b80.html|title=Owasso's Shake Milton of SMU selected to All-AAC second team|last=World|first=Kelly Hines Tulsa|work=Tulsa World|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en}}</ref>
